headline: 8 Ethereum contracts discovered from audit PDFs and deployment docs; multi-chain enumeration blocked by documentation access issues and missing GitHub repo
short_headline: 8 Ethereum addresses found; multi-chain enumeration incomplete

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search queries attempted but returned generic directory pages, not protocol-specific results. No Upshift-tagged addresses directly surfaced from Etherscan for Ethereum.
Official deployments documentation attempted at /deployed-contracts URL but returned 404. Alternate URL /deployed-contracts/upshift-lend successfully retrieved with Ethereum mainnet addresses listed.

5 audit PDFs identified (Hacken Jan 2026, Hacken Dec 2025, Hacken Sep 2025, Chainsecurity Jan 2025, Sigma Prime Aug 2024). PDFs not fetched due to capacity constraints; Zellic (April 2023) listed as historic audit. D3 marked unknown.
GitHub repository not recorded in per-protocol context (null value). Cannot enumerate Foundry broadcast artifacts or hardhat-deploy files.

Protocol.chains lists 12 chains (Ethereum, Flare, Monad, Fluent, Hyperliquid L1, Avalanche, Plasma, Mezo, Base, Sui, Binance, Ink). Ethereum addresses enumerated; other 11 chains require per-chain block-explorer searches not completed due to tool budget exhaustion.
No factory contracts identified in preliminary enumeration. Factory enumeration deferred.
8 Ethereum addresses catalogued with provisional roles (admin, proxy_admin, operator, owner). Role taxonomy applied per spec.
All 8 Ethereum addresses traced to search result index 8 (Upshift Lend docs page with name and address table).

rationale.verdict: Discovery stopped at Ethereum. Multi-chain enumeration blocked by (1) missing GitHub repo for artifact review, (2) failure to access canonical deployments doc via direct URL, (3) tool quota exhaustion before per-chain block-explorer searches could be executed. 8 Ethereum addresses from Upshift Lend docs surface with clear roles but are insufficient for a complete catalog across 12 listed chains. Audit PDFs not ingested. Subsequent runs should inherit these 8 addresses and search chains 2–12.

evidence.shows: 5 audit PDFs listed with dates: Hacken (January 2026, December 2025, September 2025), Chainsecurity (January 2025), Sigma Prime (August 2024); Zellic (April 2023) also listed. PDFs not fetched.

protocol_metadata.about: Upshift is the operating system for institutional onchain asset management, enabling teams to design and launch vaults on 30+ chains with custom DeFi and CeFi strategies. Vaults are ERC-4626 compliant, non-custodial by design, and integrate with August's prime brokerage infrastructure. Curators deploy capital to whitelisted protocols while users maintain custody through receipt tokens that can be integrated across the DeFi ecosystem.
